ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 75% low-intensity (dark gray/black) to 25% high-intensity (white/light gray) across the visible fluke surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base pigmentation is low-intensity; surface is saturated with high-intensity linear streaks and localized white circular clusters. A significant high-intensity contiguous region is visible at the distal tip of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate aperture angle of 55 degrees; notch depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular; left lobe trailing edge features three distinct semi-circular indentations. Right lobe trailing edge is severely jagged with multiple deep, irregular pixel-valleys indicating significant material loss.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature from the median notch to the lateral tips; outer edges exhibit non-linear, irregular contours due to extensive peripheral scarring.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple high-intensity circular pixel clusters concentrated primarily in the lower central region and near the trailing edge margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multi-directional, high-contrast linear disruptions (rake marks) ranging from 10 to 150 pixels in length, spanning the entire breadth of the visible ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss on trailing edges; several deep concave notches on the right lobe trailing edge and a distinct large indentation on the left lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct high-intensity (white) patch located on the distal tip and outer leading edge of the left lobe.
